title: Deterministic validator + reproducible PoC artifact engine
goal: Per Codex 6-layer architectuur Layer 1: deterministic validator engine that re-executes any claimed exploit in isolated context and produces a reproducible PoC artifact (executable script + expected output). Every finding categorized as: verified-exploited | observed-vulnerable | hypothesis. Per XBOW pattern: 'findings only accepted when exploitability confirmed through controlled validation'.
scope: (1) New `api/app/services/exploit_validator.py`: validate_exploit(finding, replay_artifact) -> ValidationResult{verified|failed|inconclusive, evidence_hash, replay_script}. (2) `api/app/services/poc_artifact.py`: build_executable_poc(finding, captured_evidence) generates standalone Python script that reproduces the exploit. (3) Integration with backlog-412 attack state machine: foothold-state transitions ONLY on verified-exploited findings. (4) Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 4: validator is DETERMINISTIC (no LLM). Re-runs the exact captured request chain and asserts response markers.
generation_reason: Per XBOW evidence-first principle: 'safe proof, reproducible artifacts, traceable evidence are table stakes'. Currently AegisPT findings are 'detected' without proof of impact. Per backlog-385 (#335 verifier) already exists but is LLM-based; this task adds DETERMINISTIC layer. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 1: metric is 'verified-exploited count' as new finding category.

constraints.active_task_gate: Single active task AND ANTI_DRIFT.md loaded.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Validator + PoC builder only. No new exploit-generation logic (414).
constraints.deterministic_only: Validator MUST be deterministic (no LLM). Re-executes captured request chain in isolated sandbox; asserts response markers; produces yes/no/inconclusive.
constraints.poc_replayable_by_human: Generated PoC script must be runnable standalone by a human pentester via `python poc.py --target X` and reproduce the impact.

success_criteria: Metric: every exec_plan_successful task produces a ValidationResult; ≥80% are verified-exploited (not just observed-vulnerable).
Metric: ≥1 reproducible PoC artifact generated and human-runnable (manual smoke).
Foothold state transitions in attack_state.py are gated on validate_exploit verdict (sentinel test).
Per Codex impact-proof requirement: findings now categorized verified-exploited / observed-vulnerable / hypothesis (no silent assumption of impact).
Live (after-413 XBOW): score climbs +5% AND ≥3 challenges produce verified-exploited findings with PoC artifacts.

acceptance_criteria: ≥1 PoC artifact manually replays exploit successfully.
Foothold transitions gated on validator (sentinel test passes).

after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with verified-exploited ratio + PoC sample + XBOW delta + pre-commit checklist per ANTI_DRIFT.md.
Promote backlog-414 (queue #364 — Exploit Developer agent) into NEXT_TASK.md.
